lines.text: The logo settles over a slow pan across a calm sea at dusk.

new_beats.text: A last band of orange light slides across the still water.

writes.note: I added a beat where the dusk light crosses the water, and kept your words as they were.

reply.rationale: The shot lacked a timed moment, so I added a quiet light beat on the sea that supports the logo and leaves room for the tagline.
